--- call_named_tvf_arguments.sql
GRAPH FinGraph
CALL FutureTVF(TABLE Singers, MODEL FutureModel, DESCRIPTOR(Id), arg => 1) @{spanner_join_method=HASH_JOIN} YIELD value
RETURN value

--- AST
&ast.GQLGraphQuery{

    PropertyGraphName: &ast.Path{
      Idents: []*ast.Ident{
        &ast.Ident{
          NamePos: 6,

        },
      },
    },
  },
  Query: &ast.GQLMultiLinearQueryStatement{
    Statements: []ast.GQLLinearQueryStatement{
      &ast.GQLSimpleLinearQueryStatement{
        Statements: []ast.GQLPrimitiveQueryStatement{

                  &ast.Ident{

              },
              Args: []ast.TVFArg{
                &ast.TableArg{

                  Name:  &ast.Path{

                  Model: 45,
                  Name:  &ast.Path{

                      &ast.ExprArg{

                },

              Yield: 123,

          &ast.GQLReturn{

                  Name:    "value",
                },

            },

}
